title: India Health 2026 to showcase India’s growing strength as a global healthcare manufacturing and innovation hub

contentHtml:
As India strengthens its position as a global healthcare manufacturing and innovation hub, the third edition of India Health 2026 will bring together industry leaders, manufacturers, healthcare providers, policymakers, innovators and global stakeholders from 21-23 August 2026 at Hall 6, Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi.

Organised by Informa Markets in India, the three-day B2B exhibition is expected to host more than 300 domestic and international brands and attract over 8,000 healthcare and medtech professionals, creating a platform for business collaboration, technology showcase, sourcing opportunities and knowledge exchange across the healthcare ecosystem.

With increasing focus on domestic manufacturing, export competitiveness, digital transformation and healthcare innovation, India Health 2026 is positioned as a platform that reflects India’s growing role in shaping the future of global healthcare and medical technology.

Against the backdrop of India’s growing emphasis on self-reliance in medical technology, supply chain localisation and healthcare innovation, India Health 2026 will spotlight the country’s expanding capabilities across medical devices and equipment, diagnostics, orthopaedics, healthcare infrastructure, healthcare IT systems and wellness technologies.

The exhibition will bring together biomedical engineers, radiologists, pathologists, clinicians, procurement leaders, distributors, hospital administrators and regulatory stakeholders, fostering meaningful engagement across the healthcare value chain.

Speaking ahead of the exhibition,Yogesh Mudras, Managing Director, Informa Markets in India, said: “India’s healthcare ecosystem is at a defining inflection point. The country’s growing manufacturing capabilities, innovation-led growth and increasing global competitiveness are reshaping how healthcare technologies are developed, produced and delivered. India Health 2026 reflects this transformation by bringing together manufacturers, innovators, healthcare providers and policymakers on a common platform to drive collaboration, accelerate technology adoption and create new business opportunities.”

“As India continues to strengthen its position as a preferred destination for healthcare manufacturing and innovation, India Health serves as a catalyst for industry partnerships, knowledge exchange and market expansion, while providing global companies an opportunity to engage with one of the world’s most dynamic healthcare markets,” he added.

Spotlight on manufacturing, innovation and global collaboration

A key highlight of this year’s edition is the Medical Manufacturing Zone, showcasing India’s growing capabilities in medical technology manufacturing and reinforcing the country’s vision of becoming a globally competitive medtech hub under the Make in India initiative.

The exhibition will also feature a dedicated International Pavilion, bringing together leading international healthcare and medical technology companies to showcase innovative solutions, explore strategic partnerships, and strengthen business engagement within India’s rapidly evolving healthcare ecosystem.

Further enhancing the event’s global profile, the Dubai Health Authority (DHA) will be exhibiting at India Health, highlighting the strengthening healthcare ties between India and the UAE and fostering opportunities for collaboration, innovation, and knowledge exchange across the healthcare sector.

To facilitate targeted business interactions, India Health 2026 will introduce a dedicated B2B Matchmaking App, enabling pre-scheduled meetings between buyers, decision-makers and exhibitors, helping enhance sourcing efficiency and collaboration outcomes.

Innovation and technology showcase

India Health 2026 will further showcase a wide range of innovations being introduced by participating companies, highlighting advances in medical imaging, orthopaedic devices, surgical technologies, AI-enabled healthcare and training solutions, and preventive healthcare.

Notable among the product launches and showcases are advanced orthopaedic implant solutions from DKS Ortho; the Indian debut of DRGEM Healthcare’s Raymo, a next-generation AI-enabled mobile X-ray system; AI-powered visual health screening solutions from FaceEcho.ai; wellness innovations from Hamdard; and KLS Martin’s marLase Pro®, a next-generation CO₂ laser platform designed for precision surgical applications across ENT, gynaecology, dermatology and other specialties.

The exhibition will also feature innovative healthcare workforce training solutions from Hxplain, including ScrubHandz™, an AI and computer vision-enabled hand hygiene training and assessment platform, and SurgiMentor™, an interactive simulation-based operating room training and skills assessment solution designed to enhance clinical competency, patient safety and workforce readiness, among many others.

Driving industry conversations

The exhibition’s conference programme themed ‘Driving Innovation to Shape the Future of Clinical Care’ will feature more than 35 sessions and over 80 speakers, including 50+ industry leaders, discussing key issues shaping the future of healthcare, including AI-powered diagnostics, preventive genetics, healthcare accessibility, digital transformation, workforce development and emerging opportunities in healthcare manufacturing.

Parallelly, the Global MedTech Conference, India’s most focused executive platform for the medical devices and diagnostic sector is also being held alongside the expo, with the summit convening regulators, industry leaders, innovators, policy architects for two days of high signal, decision grade dialogue.

India Health 2026 is supported by leading industry associations and partners including ADMI, AHPI, AMTZ, EPCMD, MTAI and TNAI (Trained Nurses’ Association of India). Coherent Market Insights joins the event as Knowledge Partner, contributing industry insights and market intelligence to support informed dialogue across the healthcare ecosystem.

As India strengthens its position in the global healthcare landscape, India Health 2026 is expected to serve as a significant industry platform showcasing the technologies, partnerships and manufacturing capabilities that will help shape the next phase of healthcare growth in the country.
